items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: I just happened to go around and follow Wooden Joe and Chris Kelly, Sam Martin. I just wanted to play trumpet

ctx.x: What about uncles and aunts and mother and daddy? None of them played? No, none of them played. None of them played. Hmm. None of them played. How did you get started yourself?

Well, it was by going by parties, yard parties. I'd go and used to have out in the old and the yards there, muddy yards, no pavement bands to be playing. Playing the blues and all that. I was quite young then. I just happened to go around and follow Wooden Joe and Chris Kelly, Sam Martin. I just wanted to play trumpet and got my old brass cornet. I was fooling around with brass all bent up. And what I did...
Just a second. Okay, you and your violins, I don't see why you don't. Well, anyway...
